About us

A little bakery with a big heart

The Oven Saga is the bakery venture of Shafali Agrawal, an alumna of Jaipuria Institute of Management — a baking studio and café in Noida where celebration cakes and bakes are made fresh to order.

From custom birthday cakes to themed gift hampers, everything is baked with love and made for your occasion.
